references.title: KD Hinged Knee Brace with Precision Locking Dials – Adjustable ROM for ACL/MCL Support, Sports & Recovery - M
references.snippet: Regain Control, Move with ConfidenceEngineered for athletes and active individuals recovering from ACL/MCL injuries or surgery, the KD Hinged Knee Brace combines medical-grade stabilization with customizable comfort. Its precision locking dials and adjustable hinges adapt to your rehabilitation or training needs, helping you stay mobile while protecting against reinjury. Why This Knee Brace Stands Out Precision Locking Dials:** Easily dial in your ideal range of motion (0° to 150°) for targeted support during rehab, sports, or daily tasks. The dual-sided hinges prevent hyperextension while promoting natural movement. Customizable Patella Support:** The open-patella design lets you adjust the gel pad’s position and size to reduce pressure points and improve alignment during squats, runs, or post-surgery recovery. Breathable All-Day Comfort:** Perforated neoprene wicks sweat and stays lightweight, while the hollowed-back design prevents overheating. Adjustable Velcro straps ensure a secure, slip-free fit over or under clothing. Stabilized for Activity:** Reinforced side supports disperse knee pressure during lateral movements—ideal for basketball, hiking, or physical therapy. Unisex Design:** Three sizes fit most adults comfortably, with dual-layer hinges and straps for durable, long-term use. Bonus: The low-profile build fits discreetly under athletic gear, so you can focus on performance, not the brace. FDA Registered: Class 1 Medical Device for trusted knee care.

references.title: Ossur Rebound Post-Op Knee Brace
references.snippet: Recover with confidence after knee surgery with the Ossur Rebound Post-Op Knee Brace. Built for ACL, PCL, MCL, and LCL repairs, meniscus surgery, and knee fractures, this hinged ROM knee brace pairs precise motion control with all-day comfort. The OneTouch hinge adjusts with a simple pull, slide, and release, so you can set exact flexion and extension limits for every phase of healing, and the drop-lock holds the knee at a fixed angle when your surgeon prescribes complete immobilization. The telescoping frame adjusts with push-button ease, extending 15 to 21 in. on the Small and 18.5 to 27 in. on the Universal and XL. Contoured paddles and non-slip straps keep the brace from migrating down your leg, while the numbered frame and color-coded blue buckles guide correct placement every time. Choose the breathable Cool design to stay dry or the cushioned, trimmable Full Foam liner for extra warmth and protection. Sizing is simple: measure your thigh 6 in. above the mid-patella. Small fits 12-25 in. and suits petite adults, slim legs, and older teens. Universal fits 16-32 in., and XL delivers a true plus size fit to 38 in. Because the ranges overlap, choose Small only if you measure under 16 in., XL only if you measure over 32 in., and Universal for everything in between. PDAC approved L1832 and L1833 and FSA and HSA eligible. Backed by the Brace Direct Perfect Fit Guarantee with free virtual fitting support from US-based specialists.

references.title: Brace Direct Osteoarthritis Knee Brace OA Offloader with ROM Hinge & Patella Comfort
references.snippet: Experience targeted unloading with the Dual Adjustment Osteoarthritis Knee Brace by Brace Direct. Built around a single ROM hinge paired with two valgus/varus adjustment points, this OA offloader helps shift weight away from the affected knee compartment while maintaining a natural gait. Dial in flexion and extension stops to support recovery goals and daily activity, and enjoy stay-put comfort from the anti-migration gel and soft foam condyle pad. The low-profile frame and lightweight, breathable straps are designed for all-day wear. Side-specific options (Left or Right) align the hinge and unloading mechanism with your anatomy for precise relief in the medial or lateral compartment. Whether youre managing osteoarthritis or addressing unicompartmental knee loading, this brace supports stability, alignment, and controlled motion without bulk. Key details include ROM control at the single hinge, two-point valgus/varus adjustment for compartment unloading, and a patella-friendly condyle pad. PDAC approved (L1843, L1851) for potential insurance reimbursementcheck with your provider. Choose Left or Right for the best alignment, and tap our Perfect Fit Promise for free video sizing and adjustment guidance from our U.S. team.
